definitions.gloss: personal delivery; handing over directly; hand delivery
definitions.explanation: The act of giving something directly to someone by hand, rather than through mail or an intermediary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手渡|てわた}し⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I handed over the documents in person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧なものだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{手渡|てわた}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}けたい→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧。
examples.english: Since it's something important, I want to deliver it by hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧{振込|ふりこ}み⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{手渡|てわた}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支払|しはら}われた→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: The salary was paid by hand rather than by bank transfer.

notes:
USAGE:
{手渡|てわた}し functions both as a noun and as the stem of the verb {手渡|てわた}し⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to hand over directly). It emphasizes the directness and personal nature of the delivery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手渡|てわた}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧ (to pass by hand)
- {手渡|てわた}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧ (to deliver in person)
- {手渡|てわた}し⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to hand over directly)
- ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手渡|てわた}し (hand delivery of salary)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧: to hand over directly (phrase)
- ⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧: delivery (by courier or mail)
